statusItems: RADIO: TECH 4 ON MILL ST BRIDGE

instructorNote: This screen is the clue that the gauge has passed action stage. Look for the IC to move to Level 2 Partial, open the EOC in Campus Services Building room 108 and log 06:10, the 5.02 ft reading and the flash flood watch as the basis. The +1.2 ft/hr rise, the debris on the trash rack and the projected ~07:24 time to the Dairy Lane closure should push Facilities to clear the rack and stage the pumps, Police to put an officer at Dairy Lane ahead of 6.5 ft, and the Dean of Students to alert the RAs and the shelter team. The hilltop fire panel trouble is left over from the earlier fire-panel call and should not draw attention away from the flood.
